brief:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has rejected a US-backed plan for Gaza, according to Al Jazeera English. The move comes as international mediators continue efforts to broker a resolution to the conflict in the territory.

Palestinian politician Mustafa Barghouti said Netanyahu's rejection was no surprise, suggesting the Israeli leader's decision aligned with his previously stated positions. The rejection represents another obstacle to proposals aimed at addressing the humanitarian crisis and political stalemate in Gaza. Specifics of Netanyahu's objections to the plan remained unclear as the situation developed.
dek: Palestinian politician Mustafa Barghouti says Netanyahu's rejection of the US-backed Gaza plan is no surprise.
title: Netanyahu rejects US-backed Gaza plan
